review: [Kurokumo Clan Wakashu] Ryoshu is an ID that focuses mainly on inflicting Bleed Count and debuffs. While her clashes are just average, she makes up for it by inflicting debuffs such as Paralyze, Offense Level Down, and Damage Down. This combined with her great Bleed infliction allows her to stay relevant in the current meta. [Kurokumo Clan Captain] Ishmael helps her a ton as it guarantees that all her debuffs will land and to top it off, she gets a +1 Bleed infliction which is great as it bumps it up to 4 Bleed Count for Skill 2 and 3.
